title: Free Eye Checkup Camp
description: A comprehensive free eye screening camp providing basic vision tests, cataract screening, and free consultations with our senior ophthalmologists.

title: Pediatric Vaccination Drive
description: Free vaccination and general health checkup for children below 12 years. Our team of expert pediatricians will be available for consultations.

title: Women's Health Awareness Program
description: An interactive awareness session on women's health, covering topics like breast cancer awareness, maternal health, and nutrition.

title: Blood Donation Camp
description: Annual blood donation camp organized in association with the Red Cross. Every drop counts. Join us in saving lives.
